sources.observed: Actual 3D loaded and orbited at 0,261,162 degrees; horseshoe/courtyard ring, front transverse range, long side roofs, rear cross range, glazed lantern. Overhead inspected at 234m altitude.
1852-53 Palladian front, seven windows 1:2:1:2:1; rustication, paired pilasters, Doric porch, Ionic upper centre, pediment sculpture, sashes, rear additions.
Portico documented as 5.5m high; metric height reference.

sources.author: Mark Wellstern
sources.observed: Maps place photo: clear whole front, double lateral flights, balustrades, two fluted Doric columns, tall pilasters, central figurative relief, two globe lamps. Scaffold on adjacent Atkinson.
Actual rendered full front and north approach, basement, stairs and floor divisions.
Actual rendered red brick/terracotta Corporation side, grouped arch windows, rectangular upper sashes, rainwater pipe.
Category searched; useful frontal photos by Alexander P Kapp (2009) and Gerald England (2002); no modern rear photo found.
